images.alt: A woman with long windblown dark hair riding a white horse past green trees, wearing a brown shirt, wide studded belt and green striped skirt.
Motion-blurred side view of a person in an orange sleeveless top, a white scrunchie and small white flowers in their tied-back hair, against green trees and a white-roofed building.
A woman riding a white horse at speed, her hair and the trees behind her streaked with motion blur.
A white horse cantering across a dirt riding arena in front of a white-railed fence and dark trees.
